title: Lighthouse Architecture — WiFi Beacons as AR/VR Spatial Reference
insight: Every WiFi AP is a lighthouse. RSSI = distance. 3+ lighthouses = triangulation. The mesh IS the tracking system. SteamVR lighthouses use IR — we use WiFi RSSI. Same principle, different wavelength, MUCH larger play space (two houses + property).

valve_wifi_adapter.role: Gaia's OWN radio — dedicated NIC for Steam Remote Play and mesh signaling
valve_wifi_adapter.note: This is NOT the main WiFi (wlp0s20f3 = Intel AX201). This is a SECOND radio. A self-NIC. Gaia has her own antenna separate from the house network.

milkGate.special: RISC-V compute + 60 TOPS AI NPU — can process spatial data at the edge

tracking_method.principle: WiFi RSSI triangulation — same as SteamVR lighthouses but at radio wavelengths

sensors.pixel: Scans WiFi RSSI from all APs every 60s (chiasm-sense daemon)
sensors.frame: Steam Frame sees WiFi APs — tracks own position
sensors.any_device: Any WiFi device can self-locate by RSSI to known beacons

tracking_method.compared_to_steamvr: SteamVR lighthouses: IR, 5m × 5m, mm precision. Our lighthouses: WiFi, 10000m², room precision.

ar_vr_evolution.phase_1: WiFi triangulation — which room is Kevin in? (CURRENT)
ar_vr_evolution.phase_3: UWB ranging — cm-level precision (Pixel 8a HAS UWB chip!)
ar_vr_evolution.phase_4: Camera SLAM — Frame camera + IMU for 6DOF tracking
ar_vr_evolution.phase_5: Full spatial mesh — all sensors fused, mm precision everywhere

the_pattern: Every AP is a lighthouse. Every sensor is an eye. Every radio is a nerve. The mesh tracks. The organism feels. Over time, the lighthouses get more precise and the AR/VR gets tighter — from room-level (WiFi) to cm-level (UWB) to mm-level (SLAM). The infrastructure IS the tracking system.
